title: Jesse Minter: Nnamdi Madubuike getting work in, trending in great direction

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jesse Minter: Nnamdi Madubuike getting work in, trending in great direction
sources.description: A report last month indicated that Ravens defensive lineman Nnamdi Madubuike plans to play this season after missing most of last year with a neck injury, but he has not been taking part in any of the team's practices this spring.
